guard/30728.htm.text: Militiaman Leirynn: Nice to meet you, stranger. My name is Leirynn and I am a militiamen in the village army of Floran. Floran is a place where people who refuse to live under the harsh ruling of the coutry's leader gather and try to live peacefully according to their own rules and laws. Therefore,…

Q00225_TestOfTheSearcher/30728-01.html.text: Militiaman Leirynn: Welcome. Recently a large group of delu lizardmen have gathered, threatening the village. We are badly outnumbered and may have to resort to guerrilla tactics. I realize that this is rather sudden, but could you please find the delu lizardmen's shaman and kill them? There are 10…

Q00225_TestOfTheSearcher/30728-02.html.text: Militiaman Leirynn: There are some shamans left. You must find all of them and kill them!

Q00225_TestOfTheSearcher/30728-04.html.text: Militiaman Leirynn: Chief Kalkis is the leader of the whole delu tribe . Why would he have brought his whole tribe here to look for something? Find out what they are looking for and kill Chief Kalkis. If you follow the path that heads towards the East, you will run into him.
